utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 7:30 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be ready by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing, honestly — do we know exactly when everyone needs to be picked up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet — can you confirm the pickup times?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I’ll need the exact list of stops first so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the carpool. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m sorry, I lost track for a minute — I think the pickup time changed, but I want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries — what’s the new pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can confirm the carpool plan and pass it along to everyone. Just tell me the pickup time and I’ll repeat it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — let’s do 7:30 a.m. at the corner by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — 7:30 a.m. at the corner by the mailboxes. I’ll pass that along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the carpool details?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nah, you’re good — the carpool’s still on. I can fill you in and lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that. Just give me the pickup time and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the carpool—just let me know the schedule and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli! I’ll send the schedule over soon and loop you in if anyone else wants a ride.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn—once you send it, I’ll follow the schedule exactly. Just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, we’re still on for tomorrow. What time should I pick you up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you pick me up at 8:15? That should give us plenty of time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help coordinate the carpool if you want—just let me know who’s riding and what time works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — it’s just me and Mina for now, and 8:15 works best. I’ll send you the pickup spot once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, 8:15 works for me. Just send the pickup spot when you’ve got it, and I’ll make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, thank you — I’m thinking weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. Would any of those work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, those times could work for me on some weekdays. I can check my schedule and let you know which days I’m available.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the list and make sure we’ve got everything for the carpool. Just tell me who’s riding with who.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send the rider groups over in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but a couple folks might be running a few minutes late. I can keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. Keep me posted and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — if I hear any changes tonight, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the pickup time and address again so I get it right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — pickup is at 3:15 PM at 24 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — 3:15 PM at 24 Maple Street. I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take Tuesdays and Thursdays if that helps, and I’ll text when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That helps a lot—I'll cover the other days and keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll let the carpool folks know and repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll make sure everyone’s on the same page too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll pass it along to the carpool group so everyone gets the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. What time were we saying again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think we said around 7:30, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 7:30 works for me — thanks for reminding me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — how about 8:15 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:15 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the carpool details organized and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rosa — just send me the pickup spot and time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the pickup spot and time as soon as I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to make sure the timing and pickup spots actually work for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get everyone’s timing and pickup spots sorted, then we can see what works best.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — if you send me the details, I’ll check whether my schedule and the route line up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing the carpool at the usual time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — let me just double-check the time before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, thanks — let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that—just tell me the pickup time and who’s riding. Then I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli—pick me up at 7:15, and it’s just me and Nora riding.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it—7:15 for you and Nora. I’ll be there on time and keep us on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but I’m not totally sure about the pickup time yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the pickup time and let you know so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep my phone handy in case you hear back soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m in, I just need to double-check the time so I don’t mix it up again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem — I can send you the time again if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, please do — that’d really help. I’ll put it somewhere I can’t lose it this time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday, but I’ll need to swap if the schedule changes. What time should I plan to be there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s plan for 3:15 if that works for you. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 works for me. Thanks for letting me know if anything changes.
